name: The My Clips page turned off in Plugin Pages' host, as admin in the Auto host mode (PageHostMode=Auto at startup, so Plugin Pages registered My Clips): the page turned off with EnableClipsPage (read per request, no restart): Plugin Pages' link to it, still there until the next restart, shows "My Clips is turned off by your server admin." in its host (the shell's 200 note), never a blank page; the capabilities say Pages.Clips false; then the setting is put back on and the page renders again. Run by hand as scripts/README.md describes, which also puts the host mode back.

steps.name: index.html carries Plugin Pages' tag (its startup task registers a few seconds after the server starts)
steps.waitFor: fetch(new URL('index.html', location.href), { cache: 'no-store' }).then(r => r.text()).then(t => t.indexOf('<script plugin="PluginPages"') >= 0)

steps.name: reload, so the page has the tag

warm-up (Bookmarks 1.2.1, as pages-pluginpages.json's): reload once after the sign-in, so the web client starts with the signed-in user from its first request (the first run after a start found the drawer empty, jellyfin-web having asked Users/null/...)
the user known, the Bookmarks script ran and the drawer's user menu built
the kit chose the Plugin Pages host for My Clips
EnableClipsPage off through the configuration API
steps.script: const id = 'd0ee1b2a-7f71-4654-8ff2-163a81441b03'; const c = await ApiClient.getPluginConfiguration(id); c.EnableClipsPage = false; await ApiClient.updatePluginConfiguration(id, c); const r = await ApiClient.getPluginConfiguration(id); return { EnableClipsPage: r.EnableClipsPage, PageHostMode: r.PageHostMode };

steps.name: drawer open
steps.waitFor: (() => { const a = document.querySelector('.mainDrawer .userMenuOptions'); if (!a) return false; const b = a.getBoundingClientRect(); return b.width > 0 && b.height > 0; })()

steps.name: Plugin Pages' link to My Clips, still there until the next restart
steps.waitFor: (() => { const a = [...document.querySelectorAll('.mainDrawer a')].find(x => (x.getAttribute('href') || '').indexOf('pageUrl=%2FBookmarks%2FPages%2Fclips') >= 0 || (x.getAttribute('href') || '').indexOf('pageUrl=/Bookmarks/Pages/clips') >= 0); return a ? { href: a.getAttribute('href'), text: a.textContent.trim() } : false; })()

steps.name: follow it
steps.script: const a = [...document.querySelectorAll('.mainDrawer a')].find(x => (x.getAttribute('href') || '').indexOf('Pages%2Fclips') >= 0 || (x.getAttribute('href') || '').indexOf('Pages/clips') >= 0); a.click(); return true;

steps.name: the host shows the shell's note "My Clips is turned off by your server admin.", not a blank page; no page of ours mounted
steps.waitFor: (() => { const v = [...document.querySelectorAll('.userPreferencesPage:not(.hide)')].find(x => x.getClientRects().length > 0); if (!v) return false; const t = v.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); if (t.indexOf('My Clips is turned off by your server admin.') < 0) return false; return { note: true, marker: !!v.querySelector('[data-jfbm-page="clips"]'), mounted: !!v.querySelector('[data-jfbm-mounted]'), hash: location.hash.split('&')[0] }; })()

steps.name: the turned-off note in Plugin Pages' host
the shell answers 200 with the note and no page marker
steps.script: const r = await fetch(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/Pages/clips'), { headers: { Authorization: 'MediaBrowser Token="' + ApiClient.accessToken() + '"' } }); const t = await r.text(); return { status: r.status, note: t.indexOf('My Clips is turned off by your server admin.') >= 0, marker: t.indexOf('data-jfbm-page=') >= 0 };

steps.name: EnableClipsPage back on
steps.script: const id = 'd0ee1b2a-7f71-4654-8ff2-163a81441b03'; const c = await ApiClient.getPluginConfiguration(id); c.EnableClipsPage = true; await ApiClient.updatePluginConfiguration(id, c); return (await ApiClient.getPluginConfiguration(id)).EnableClipsPage;
